item.title: Entrepreneurship and Institutions in Latin America: Strategic Management of High-Impact Ventures and Entrepreneurial Ecosystems
item.content:encoded:
Veneta Andonova, Universidad de los Andes

Sascha Fuerst, Tecnologico de Monterrey

Carlos Rodriguez, INCAE Business School

This special issue examines how strategic management and entrepreneurial ecosystems interact within Latin America's institutional contexts. It focuses on high-impact ventures and ecosystem elements—capital, talent, norms, and policy—to understand how strategic decisions amid volatility reshape these ecosystems. The issue seeks comparative metrics of entrepreneurial output, case studies of venture-scaling strategies, and policy frameworks for institutional interventions.

The special issue fills a gap by combining strategic management and entrepreneurship through an institutional lens specific to Latin America. It examines how high-impact ventures reshape their ecosystem components, highlights intermediaries like accelerators and incubators, and introduces measurement frameworks suited to informality and rapid digitalization in the Global South.

Appel publié par European Business Review. Lire l'appel complet sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Institutional architectures and high-impact ventures in Latin America
  • Scaling strategies under institutional voids and macroeconomic volatility
  • Comparative metrics for entrepreneurship research in the Global South
  • Entrepreneurial ecosystem intermediaries in Latin America
  • Public policy instruments and regulatory experimentation
  • Feedback effects between firm-level strategic choices and institutional change
